_comment_id: id must resolve to exactly the same URL as start_url. 'dfl-hq' resolved to /dfl-hq (no trailing slash) while start_url is /dfl-hq/, and a mismatch can stop Chrome offering a real install.
name: DFL HQ
description: League headquarters for the DFL: rules, keepers, polls, finances, owner history and league events.
_comment_display: 'browser' is deliberately NOT listed here. It is not an app display mode, and listing it gains nothing while risking the app being treated as a plain tab.
_comment_icons: app-* uses an edge-to-edge graphite field so each launcher supplies its own mask without exposing an inset frame. The maskable artwork keeps the full shield and feathers inside the adaptive safe zone.
